base_recipe_margin_band.note: A shallow base margin band for choosing clean shop prices. Efficiency is expected to increase realized margin later without raising the canonical output price.

Rock.note: Ordinary stone/rock anchor. Limestone is intentionally not assumed to share this value.

StoneRoadItem.note: Public Exchange price. Placement/removal policy is a government incentive, not part of the item production price.

IronBarItem.note: Current working downstream input value. Full mining/smelting chain audit will determine the canonical producer/public-buy value.

StampMillItem.note: Immediate live-server price pending full Mechanics dependency audit. Based on 5 Iron Bars, 14 Screws, 8 Iron Gears, 14 WoodBoard-tag inputs, and 120 calories at Mechanics 2.
